title: 第7章 碧潭幽谷林玄至第8章 斩幽蟒小人作祟
content_zh:
旁边的严师兄安抚道：“何师妹别怕，不一定是那碧潭幽蟒，很可能是碧水青蛇的同族呢？那样我们就有可以抓捕一条了！”
严师兄说着，目光不掩贪婪之色，朝着前面走去探查。
几人看着严师兄的背影前去，突然前方一声“轰隆”巨响。
前方那座小山坡居然直接被削平了，而前去探查的严师兄更是倒飞回来了，口吐鲜血。
“噗！！”
“严师兄！”
“严师弟！”
几人连忙扶住严师兄，紧接着，只见一头全身碧绿的巨蟒抬起巨大头颅，俯视众人！
赫然就是前方洞穴内的碧潭幽蟒！
它足足有十几米长，直径半米多，那尾巴处的蛇皮鳞片如刀剑一般锋利，刚刚那座小山坡就是被它一尾巴给扫没了的。
可怕至极！
......
碧潭幽谷外围。
林玄一路磨练剑法，刚来到了这里，察觉到了一些人为的痕迹。
“这打斗痕迹好像是刚刚留下的，前方就是碧潭幽谷深处，难道是有人也想要碧潭幽蟒？”
林玄自言自语着，摇了摇头，碧潭幽蟒实力不低，没有人会像自己一样需要它那伴生莲花而去挑战它吧？
“顾不得这剑域凝聚了，伴生莲花重要！”
只不过林玄还是有点担心自己的药引被破坏，随即加快了脚步朝着内围而去。
......
这一边。

祝红菱四人跟碧潭幽蟒缠斗在一起，几人可谓是使尽了法宝，浑身解数，都无法伤到碧潭幽蟒半分。
而且几人还都受了不小的伤。
特别是严师兄，第一下被碧潭幽蟒尾巴直接就扫的重伤了，后面的缠斗也是心有余而力不足。
“这畜生的皮甲太厚了，它的防御我们根本破不掉！”
“噗！”
邱师兄又被扇飞，刚说完话就忍不住吐了一口鲜血。
严师兄受伤之后，基本上是他跟祝红菱在挡着，这一下，他的伤势基本上跟严师兄持平了。
“祝师妹，你可还有什么符篆？赶紧用出来吧！不然我们都得死在这里！”严师兄一直在观战养伤，眼见形势不对，连忙对着祝红菱喊道。
此话一出，众人也是纷纷朝着祝红菱看去，毕竟祝红菱父亲是祝天虹，应该有点防身之物。
“还有一张三阶金刚伏魔符，可是凭我自己根本无法激发，需要你们来帮忙！”
在这个紧要关头，祝红菱只好拿出了最后一张底牌，毕竟命重要，宝物出去之后，再找她父亲祝天虹要就是了。
众人看着祝红菱手上的金刚伏魔符，都不由得露出了羡慕贪婪之色，要知道，这金刚伏魔符可是三阶啊！！
比刚刚祝红菱拿出的二阶奔雷符不知道宝贵了多少倍！
“没问题！我们一起来！有了这三阶符篆，也够这碧潭幽蟒喝一壶的了！”严师兄伤势似乎好了不少，此时竟第一个站了起来，出声道。
“是啊，祝师妹放心！话费这等宝符，回去以后我等定会补偿你！”邱师兄也站起身来。
“是啊，呜呜，还好有你在祝师姐。”何师妹一副娇弱模样颇为哭泣说道。
旁边的严师兄不停的安慰。
content_en:
Senior Brother Yan next to him said comfortingly: "Junior Sister He, don't be afraid. It may not necessarily be the Green Pool Snake, but it may be a member of the Blue Water Green Snake. Then we can capture one!"
Senior Brother Yan said, without hiding his greedy look, he walked forward to investigate.
Several people looked at Senior Brother Yan's back and headed forward, when suddenly there was a loud "bang" in front of them.
The hillside in front was flattened, and Senior Brother Yan who went to investigate flew back, vomiting blood.
"Poof!!"
"Senior Brother Yan!"
"Junior Brother Yan!"
Several people hurriedly supported Senior Brother Yan, and then, they saw a giant python with a green body raising its huge head and looking down at everyone!
Surprisingly, it is the Bitan Youbo in the cave ahead!
It was more than ten meters long and more than half a meter in diameter. The snakeskin scales on its tail were as sharp as a sword. The hillside just now was swept away by its tail.
Extremely scary!
...
The outskirts of Bitan Valley.
Lin Xuan has been honing his sword skills all the way, and when he first arrived here, he noticed some man-made traces.
"The traces of the fight seem to have been left just now. Ahead is the depths of the Bitan Valley. Could it be that someone also wants the Bitan Nether Python?"
Lin Xuan muttered to himself and shook his head. The strength of the Bitan Youbo was not low. No one would challenge it because it needed its accompanying lotus as much as he did, right?
"Ignore the fact that the sword realm is condensed, the accompanying lotus is important!"
However, Lin Xuan was still a little worried that his medicine guide would be destroyed, so he quickened his pace and headed towards the inner circle.
...
This side.
Zhu Hongling and four other people were fighting with the Bitan Youbo. They used all their magic weapons and tried their best, but they couldn't even injure the Bitan Youbo.
Moreover, several people suffered considerable injuries.
Especially Senior Brother Yan, who was severely injured by the tail of the Bitan Serpent Python in the first blow, and was unable to do anything in the subsequent fight.
"This beast's leather armor is too thick, and we can't break through its defense!"
"Poof!"
Senior Brother Qiu was slapped away again. As soon as he finished speaking, he couldn't help but vomit a mouthful of blood.
After Senior Brother Yan was injured, he and Zhu Hongling were basically blocking him. This time, his injuries were basically on the same level as Senior Brother Yan.
"Junior Sister Zhu, do you have any other talismans? Use them quickly! Otherwise we will all die here!" Senior Brother Yan has been watching the battle to recover from his injuries. Seeing that the situation is not right, he quickly shouted to Zhu Hongling.
As soon as these words came out, everyone looked at Zhu Hongling. After all, Zhu Hongling's father was Zhu Tianhong, so he should have something for self-defense.
"There is also a third-level Vajra Demon-Conquering Talisman, but I can't activate it on my own. I need your help!"
At this critical moment, Zhu Hongling had no choice but to pull out her last trump card. After all, life was important. After the treasure was out, she would go to her father Zhu Tianhong to get it.
Everyone looked at the Diamond Demon-Conquering Talisman in Zhu Hongling's hand and couldn't help but show envy and greed. You must know that this Diamond Demon-Conquering Talisman is of the third level! !
I don’t know how many times more valuable than the second-level Thunder Talisman that Zhu Hongling took out just now!
"No problem! Let's come together! With this third-level talisman, it's enough for this Bitan Youbo to drink a pot!" Senior Brother Yan's injury seemed to have improved a lot. At this time, he was the first to stand up and spoke out.
"Yes, junior sister, I wish you peace of mind! I will definitely compensate you for the phone bill and such a treasure after you go back!" Senior Brother Qiu also stood up.
"Yes, wuwu, it's a good thing you're here to wish me senior sister." Junior Sister He said with a delicate look and was crying.
Senior Brother Yan next to him kept comforting him.
